blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像模型可以通过提炼一个以视觉语言评论家修正的即时性为条件的自师,从自己的错误中吸取教训. 然而,这种自我老师几乎没有改进对齐性,他们和他们的后视-相隔变体都吸收了评论家对场景的意外添加,如照明或风景. 我们将此归因于两个因素:(1)提示已经指定了想要的固定,所以一个有用的修改必须超越失败的跨度,经常重写整个场景,并添加一些使固定蒙上阴影的细节;(2)虽然批评者将错误定位到一个跨度,但自我老师在重写上的条件,用意想不到的添加来将预定的固定包围起来. 在这些见解的激励下,我们提出Hindsight Twins(HinT),它让评论家的审校模板一次充满了预期的固定,一次充满了所观察到的误差,并且只蒸馏了他们的速率差异,在用户的迅速下锚. 因为文本编码器将单一插槽的编辑传播到所有其他的符号上,HinT进一步将双胞胎的符号状态比对到槽外. 横跨Quen-Image-2512,SD3.5-M和FLUX.2-Klein, HinT将批评者引发的偏差率保持在基模水平上,同时匹配或超过之前自我消化的对齐收益,并在对比性基线衰减的地方不断改进超过十二轮的自我训练.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While a vision-language model (VLM) can readily diagnose generation errors such as missing objects or wrong counts [ 11 , 23 , 15 ] , turning its critique into weight updates remains difficult. Applying reinforcement learning (RL) [ 7 , 32 ] collapses each critique into a scalar reward, discarding which requirement failed and how to fix it. Group-based online RL [ 32 , 59 ] also needs multiple rollouts per prompt for advantage estimation, failing under a single-rollout budget in Sec. 4 . To preserve verbal feedback in one rollout [ 1 , 27 ] , on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) [ 58 , 20 ] supervises failed student samples with a teacher conditioned on the critic’s revised prompt [ 44 , 41 , 29 , 50 , 47 ] : the positive self-teacher distills this revision directly, whereas the cross-author pair contrasts it with a hindsight-edited user prompt to push away from the error in the failed image.
blocks.zh: 虽然视觉语言模型(VLM)可以很容易地诊断出生成错误,如缺失对象或错误的计数[11,23,15],但将其批评转化为重量更新仍然是困难的. 应用强化学习(RL)[7,32] 使每个批评都崩溃成悬赏,放弃了哪些要求失败以及如何修复它. 基于集团的在线RL [32,59] 还需要每次快速推出多个选项以进行优势估计,在Sec. 4的单一推出预算下失败. 为了在一次推出[1,27]中保留口头反馈,关于政策的自我消化[OPSD][58,20] 监督有教师条件的失败学生样本在评论员订正的即时[44,41,29,50,47]: 正面的自导师直接提炼了这个修改,而交叉的作者配对则将其与一个后视编辑的用户进行对比,促使其推开失败的图像中的错误.

blocks.en: However, both designs assume that a revision modifies only the diagnosed error. In practice, asked for a complete, more explicit prompt [ 50 , 29 , 47 ] , the critic rewrites the whole scene in its own style. When “four brown monkeys” yields only three in , for instance, it restores the count (“four”) within an unrequested scene: “A family of four brown monkeys sitting together on a mossy log, lit by warm, golden sunset light.” In language modeling, contrastive self-distillation cancels such style drift by placing positive and negative solutions in a shared template [ 38 , 5 ] , whereas the cross-author pair contrasts this free-form description against a minimal user-prompt edit (“three brown monkeys”), leaving the rewrite intact. As Sec. 2.1 shows, the positive self-teacher barely improves alignment, and both baselines absorb what the critic adds, from unrequested scenery to sunset lighting in over 82% of test images under a sunset-favoring critic. Yet replacing only the failed span in the user’s prompt is no option either: since the prompt already states the desired fix, it stays unchanged and yields no training signal. Thus, we attribute this dilemma to two factors:
blocks.zh: 然而,两种设计都假设修订只修改确诊错误. 在实践中,评论家要求有一个完整,更明确的提示[50,29,47],评论家以自己的风格改写了整个场景. 例如,当“四只棕色猴子”在未经要求的场景中只产生三只时,它恢复了“四只”的计数:“一个四只棕色猴子组成的家庭坐在苔藓木上,被温暖、金色的日落光照亮。” 在语言建模中,对比性自我消化会通过将正反两种溶液放入共享模板[38,5]来取消这种风格漂移,而交叉作者的配对则将这种自由形式描述与最小的用户速率编辑(“三个棕色猴子”)作对比,使重写完好无损. 正如第2.1条所示,积极的自我教师几乎无法改善校正,两个基线都吸收了评论家所补充的内容,从未经要求的风景到82%以上的测试图像在日落喜悦的批评者面前的夕阳照明。 然而,在用户的提示中只替换失败的跨度也是没有选择的:由于提示已经说明想要的固定,它保持不变,没有产生训练信号。 因此,我们把这一两难处境归因于两个因素:

blocks.en: • Because replacing only the failed span leaves the original prompt unchanged, a meaningful revision must expand the prompt; in doing so, the critic rewrites the entire scene, introducing unrequested setting, lighting, and phrasing that far outweigh the fix. • Although the critic can localize the error to a specific span, existing self-teachers condition on the entire rewritten prompt without controlling for these additional changes, so their supervision entangles the intended fix with the critic’s unrequested additions.

blocks.en: Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which restores span-level localization inside the critic’s own wording. Alongside the observed error and the intended fix, the critic returns its revision as a slotted template; filling the slot with the fix yields the revised prompt, whereas filling it with the observed error yields its hindsight twin , a critic-worded description that the failed sample already satisfies [ 3 , 57 ] . By comparison, contrasting the user’s prompt against its hindsight edit is also span-local, but it lacks scene context and trains unstably in Sec. 4 . Because text encoders propagate a single-slot edit to surrounding tokens, HinT further aligns the twin’s token states outside the slot to those of the revision in Sec. 3.3 . With the two prompts matched outside the slot, adding the teacher velocity difference between the two prompts to the original-prompt anchor cancels the shared rewrite and keeps only the fix in Fig. 3 , so refreshing the teacher from the student each round compounds the correction rather than the critic’s habits.
blocks.zh: 基于这些洞察力,我们提出“光明双胞胎”(Hindsight Twins,HinT),在评论家自己的措辞中恢复跨度本地化。 除了观察到的错误和预定的固定,评论家将修改结果作为时间档模板返回;用固定值填充槽产生订正的及时值,而用观察到的错误填充则产生其后视双值。 相比之下,将用户的提示与其后视编辑的对比也是跨度局部的,但它缺乏场景背景,在Sec. 4中不可靠地列车. 由于文本编码器向周围的符号传播一个单片段编辑,HinT进一步将插槽外的双子符号状态与Sec中的修订状态相匹配. 3.3 (英语). 由于两个提示在插槽外匹配,将两个提示之间的老师速度差加到原创-即时主播上,取消了共享的重写,只保留了图3中的固定,因此每轮让老师从学生那里刷新会增加校正而不是评论家的习惯.

blocks.en: Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT consistently improves compositional alignment without inheriting the critic’s visual habits, and sustains its gains over multi-round training. On held-out GenEval2 prompts, it raises EMA Soft-TIFA geometric mean (GM) over the base model by 11.4, 11.1, and 1.9 points (2.8 current; 7.9 EMA at round twelve) on the three backbones, respectively; compared with the cross-author pair, it leads by 4.4 and 1.6 points on Qwen-Image-2512 and SD3.5-M, and overtakes it on FLUX.2-klein as the pair decays over rounds, while keeping habit rates at the base-model level under sunset, cold-light, and vintage critics. Extended analysis in Sec. 5 further validates our diagnosis: adding the rewrite back into HinT’s target reintroduces the critic’s habit without improving alignment, forbidding the critic from expanding the prompt hurts contrastive gains, and aligning token states keeps critic-added scenery out of the contrast.
blocks.zh: 横跨Quen-Image-2512,SD3.5-M,以及FLUX. 双脚 HinT在不继承评论家的视觉习惯的情况下,不断改善成分配乐,并维持其在多轮训练上的成果. 在被搁置的 GenEval2 提示上,它将EMA Soft-TIFA 几何平均值(GM)分别提升11.4,11.1和1.9分(2.8 current;7.9 EMA at round 12)在三个主干上;与交叉作者对比,它在Quen-Image-2512和SD3.5-M上领先4.4和1.6分,并在FLUX上超越. 2-klein作为对子在轮回中衰变,同时在日落,冷光和古董批评者面前保持基模水平的习惯率. Sec. 5的扩展分析进一步验证了我们的诊断:在HinT的目标中添加重写内容,重新引入评论家的习惯而不改进校正,禁止评论家扩大迅速的伤害对比性收益,以及调整标志性状态使得评论家增加的场景脱离了对比性。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: • We diagnose why text-to-image self-distillation inherits the critic’s style: through a velocity-space decomposition and controlled habit probes, we show that the critic’s scene rewrite dominates the teacher signal and compounds into a student habit that cross-author contrasts fail to cancel. • We propose Hindsight Twins, which fills a slotted critic revision with the intended fix and the observed error, distilling their velocity difference under an evolving teacher. • We introduce token-state alignment, which keeps the twins identical outside the slot in feature space, preventing critic-added scenery from leaking into the contrast.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献有三个方面: 我们分析为什么文字对图像的自我消化会继承评论家的风格:通过速度-空间分解和控制的习惯探针,我们显示评论家的场景将老师的信号和复合体重写成学生的习惯,而交叉作者的对比无法取消。 我们提议 " 光眼双胞胎 " ,它用预定的修补和观察到的误差填补了批评者的时间档,在不断演变的教师的领导下,提炼出他们的速度差异。 我们引入了令牌状态对齐,使双胞胎在插槽外的特征空间中保持完全相同,防止了添加评论的风景渗入对比.

blocks.en: 2.1 Self-Teachers Inherit the Critic’s Rewrite
blocks.zh: 2.1 自我教师继承批评者重写

blocks.en: On-policy self-distillation uses a critic’s revised prompt to guide the student whenever a generated image misses a requirement. Because the user’s prompt already states that requirement, replacing only the failed span with the intended fix leaves the prompt unchanged and provides no training signal. Prior self-teachers [ 50 , 29 , 47 ] therefore ask the critic to expand the prompt into a complete, more explicit scene description. However, expanding the prompt causes the critic to rewrite the entire scene in its own style. As detailed in Appendix B , this behavior is pervasive across our experiments, where the default Qwen3-VL-32B critic expands 10-word median prompts into 22 to 25-word descriptions and adds unrequested setting or lighting in 59% to 74% of revisions.

blocks.en: Our distillation experiments show that training on these expanded revisions causes the student to internalize the critic’s scene preferences as visual habits. Under the default critic, both the positive self-teacher and the cross-author pair replace plain backgrounds with the critic’s added scenery in Appendix Tab. 12 , while the positive self-teacher barely improves alignment. We further test this habit transfer in a controlled setting by instructing the critic to include warm sunset light, cold light, or vintage film in every revised scene while keeping its error diagnosis unchanged. Both baselines readily absorb each injected habit across backbones: on SD3.5-M in Fig. 2 b, they incur 45 to 97 percentage points of habit takeover while yielding minimal or negative GM gains. Over training rounds in Fig. 2 c, sunset prevalence under both baselines jumps from 2.2% to over 80% with a frozen teacher, and reaches nearly 100% within two rounds for the cross-author pair when its teacher is updated from the student each round. Prompting the critic to restrain its rewrite [ 50 ] fails to block injected habits, while forcing minimal edits sacrifices alignment gains, as shown in Appendix Tab. 7 .

blocks.en: 2.2 Localizing the Correction Is Necessary

blocks.en: Keeping the teacher fixed at the base model θ 0 \theta_{0} caps how much the student can improve, since every update still anchors the student to the initial model. To accumulate gains across rounds, HinT updates the teacher to the current student ( θ ¯ ← θ \bar{\theta}\leftarrow\theta ) at the start of each round, samples a fresh set of rollouts for the critic to judge, and maintains an exponential moving average (EMA) of the student’s LoRA weights [ 18 , 42 ] , as summarized in Appendix Alg. 1 . Refreshing the teacher, however, compounds whatever signal is present in the target. When the target retains the rewrite drift Δ drift \Delta_{\rm drift} , each new teacher inherits the critic’s style from the previous round and amplifies it further, as shown in Fig. 2 c. Because HinT cancels the shared rewrite in Δ twin \Delta_{\rm twin} and anchors accepted rollouts at 𝒗 θ ¯ ​ ( c ) \bm{v}_{\bar{\theta}}(c) , each teacher refresh carries forward only the learned corrections.

Our baselines isolate the role of each component in HinT.
The positive self-teacher [ 29 , 50 , 47 ] supervises the student directly with 𝒗 θ ¯ ​ ( r ) \bm{v}_{\bar{\theta}}(r) via Eq. 2 , distilling the critic’s full revision without filtering.
To subtract what the failed image already shows, the cross-author pair contrasts the full revision r r against the user-worded hindsight prompt h h , adding 𝒗 θ ¯ ​ ( r ) − 𝒗 θ ¯ ​ ( h ) \bm{v}_{\bar{\theta}}(r)-\bm{v}_{\bar{\theta}}(h) to 𝒗 θ ¯ ​ ( c ) \bm{v}_{\bar{\theta}}(c) .
The user-worded hindsight contrast instead contrasts c c against h h directly in the user’s words, isolating a local edit without the critic’s scene context.
Rather than operating in velocity space, SFT on the revised prompt applies r r at the sample level: it regenerates failed images from r r , keeps those that pass the critic under c c , and fine-tunes on them with flow matching.
Finally, DiffusionNFT [ 59 ] replaces verbal critiques with a scalar reward (the fraction of satisfied questions per rollout) for on-policy RL.

blocks.en: 5 Extended Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 扩展分析

blocks.en: This section validates two factors behind HinT’s effectiveness in student training: (1) canceling rewrite drift in the target while keeping the expanded scene in the template is essential for alignment; and (2) aligning non-slot token states keeps the contrast local, blocking scene leakage and focusing updates on failed bindings. Sec. 5.3 further tests robustness to critic errors.
blocks.zh: 本节验证了HinT在学生培训中效力的两个因素:(1) 取消目标重写漂移,同时将扩展的场景保留在模板中对于校正至关重要;(2) 校正非音标状态保持对比度局部,屏蔽场景渗漏,并将更新聚焦于失败绑定. 第5.3节进一步测试批评错误是否有力。

blocks.en: 5.1 Role of the Critic’s Scene Rewrite
blocks.zh: 5.1 批评者角色重写

blocks.en: Sec. 2.2 showed in velocity space that rewrite drift Δ drift \Delta_{\rm drift} dominates whole-prompt updates, whereas contrasting the failed span inside a shared scene isolates the local fix Δ twin \Delta_{\rm twin} . blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: While reward models and vision-language critics can readily assess generated images, turning their feedback into stronger single-pass generation remains challenging. Existing approaches fall into three categories: test-time revision, scalar-reward reinforcement learning, and multimodal self-rewarding loops. Test-time prompt rewriting [ 16 ] and iterative self-reflection [ 36 , 61 ] refine generations without updating model weights, but add extra VLM calls and resampling to every user request. Post-training methods instead internalize feedback into the generator so inference stays single-pass: preference optimization and online policy-gradient methods such as DDPO [ 7 ] , Diffusion-DPO [ 45 ] , Flow-GRPO [ 32 ] , DanceGRPO [ 54 ] , and DiffusionNFT [ 59 ] optimize generators from external reward models, though group-based policy gradients require multiple rollouts per prompt to estimate relative advantages reliably. Unified self-improvement frameworks including SRUM [ 23 ] , UniCorn [ 11 ] , and Dreaming in Flow [ 15 ] remove separate reward models by critiquing self-generated images with a VLM, yet still convert feedback into scalar rewards or sample-level supervision rather than dense trajectory-level corrections. Unlike test-time revision that slows inference or reward-based post-training that discards localized error diagnoses and needs multiple rollouts per prompt, our proposed HinT turns structured VLM critiques from a single rollout per prompt into dense trajectory supervision, enabling self-improvement while keeping inference single-pass and VLM-free.
blocks.zh: 虽然奖励模式和视觉语言批评者可以随时评估生成的图像,但将其反馈转化为更强大的单一通道生成仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法分为三类:测试时间修订、scalar-ward加强学习和多式联运自我奖励循环。 测试时间即时重写 [16] 和迭代自反写 [36,61] 在不更新模型权重的情况下精炼代代,但在每一个用户请求中都添加额外的VLM调用和重印. 培训后的方法将反馈输入生成器,因此推论保持不变:优化偏好和在线政策分级方法,如DDPO[7],Difumation-DPO[45],Flow-GRPO[32],DanceGRPO[54],DifumationNFT[59],优化外部奖励模式的生成器,尽管基于团体的政策梯度要求每次迅速多次推出,以可靠地估计相对优势. 统一的自我改进框架,包括SRUM [23],UniCorn [11],和Dreaming in Flow [15] 移除单独的奖励模型,方法是用VLM来点缀自生成的图像,然而仍然将反馈转换为scalar奖励或样本级监督,而不是密集的轨迹级校正. 与试验时间修订会延缓推论或基于奖励的后训练会抛弃局部误差诊断, 并且需要每次快速多次推出不同, 我们提议的HinT将结构化的 VLM 批评从每次快速推出一次转向密集的轨迹监督,

blocks.en: To obtain dense step-wise supervision from a single rollout per prompt [ 1 , 35 , 27 ] , on-policy distillation trains a student along its own trajectories. Extending this paradigm to diffusion and flow-matching models, recent methods query a stronger external teacher [ 28 , 12 ] , extrapolate along policy or guidance differences under a shared prompt [ 55 , 48 , 52 , 30 , 26 ] , or perform teacher-free self-distillation [ 60 , 56 ] . Following privileged-context self-distillation in language models [ 44 , 41 , 58 , 20 , 38 , 5 , 39 ] , visual self-teachers condition the generator itself on reference images [ 22 , 8 ] or critic-rewritten prompts [ 29 , 50 , 47 ] . Distilling an expanded prompt directly works well when the goal is to internalize general prompt enhancement, as in PE-OPSD [ 29 ] . When correcting generation errors, however, the user’s prompt already states the desired requirement, so replacing only the failed span leaves it unchanged and forces the critic to expand and rewrite the entire scene; distilling this full revision [ 50 , 47 ] entangles the local fix with unrequested scenery that outweighs the correction, and refreshing an evolving teacher [ 42 ] each round compounds those critic habits much as iterative self-training amplifies distribution shifts [ 2 , 40 ] . Our proposed HinT resolves these limitations by pairing the intended fix with a hindsight twin of the observed error inside a shared slotted critic template, aligning non-slot token states in feature space so the slot edit does not leak into surrounding scene tokens, and focusing the contrast on high-noise steps [ 21 ] before refreshing the teacher.
blocks.zh: 为获得密集的渐进式监督,每一次快速推出[1,35,27],在政策上蒸馏会沿自己的轨迹训练学生. 将这一模式推广到传播和流动匹配模式,最近的方法询问一个更强大的外部教师[28、12],在共享的速率下根据政策或指导差异推导[55、48、52、30、26],或进行无教师自我消化[60、56]。 在语言模型中的特权文字自我消化[44、41、58、20、38、5、39]之后,视觉自导师以参考图像[22、8]或评论-重写提示[29、50、47]作为生成器本身的条件。 当目标是将一般的即时增强内部化时,如PE-OPSD[29]中那样,将扩大的快速分解直接有效。 然而,在纠正生成错误时,用户的提示已经陈述了期望的要求,因此只有失败的跨度才没有改变,并迫使批评者扩展和改写整个场景;提炼出这个完整的修订[50,47] 将本地的定点布局缠绕在未经要求的场景上,超过校正,并刷新一名不断发展的教师[42]每轮使这些批评者的习惯更加复杂,因为迭代自我训练会放大分布的转变[2,40]. 我们提出的HinT解决了这些限制,在共享的时档评论员模板中将预定的固定与所观察到的误差的后视双对齐,在特征空间中将非鼠标状态对齐,以便槽编辑不会漏入周围的场景标志,在刷新老师之前将对比点放在高噪音步骤[21]上.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Text-to-image self-distillation inherits a critic’s stylistic habits because useful revisions expand the whole scene, leaving updates dominated by scene rewrite rather than the fix. We propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which pairs the intended fix and observed error inside a slotted critic template and aligns non-slot token states in feature space, compounding only the span-local correction under an evolving teacher. Across three rectified-flow backbones, HinT improves compositional alignment and zero-shot transfer, keeps habit rates at base levels under biased critics, and sustains its gains over twelve rounds where contrastive baselines decay.
blocks.zh: 文字对图像的自我消化继承了评论家的风格习惯,因为有用的修改扩展了整个场景,使得更新以场景重写而不是固定为主. 我们提出“光线双胞胎”(HinT), 将预定的固定和观察到的误差对齐, 纵观三个整流主干线,HinT改进了结构对齐和零射转接,将习惯率保持在基准水平上受到有偏见的批评,并在对比性基线衰减的十二轮中维持其收益。

blocks.en: Expanding Sec. 3.3 , we encode r = T ⁡ ( f ) r=T(f) and r ~ = T ⁡ ( a ) \tilde{r}=T(a) separately through each backbone’s text encoder and copy r r ’s hidden states onto r ~ \tilde{r} outside the edited slot. Under bidirectional encoders, the slot edit propagates to both sides of the prompt: on SD3.5-M, which combines CLIP-L and CLIP-G token features with bidirectional T5-XXL states, span replacement copies r r ’s hidden states onto r ~ \tilde{r} at all positions outside the differing token span in each encoder while retaining r ~ \tilde{r} ’s pooled CLIP projections. Under causal encoders, namely Qwen2.5-VL in Qwen-Image-2512 and Qwen3 in FLUX.2-klein, tokens before the slot cannot attend to it and already share identical states, so alignment reduces to suffix alignment . Specifically, we match the longest common prefix and valid suffix of the two unpadded token sequences (accommodating slots of different token lengths) and copy r r ’s hidden states onto the corresponding valid suffix positions of r ~ \tilde{r} , leaving slot and padding tokens untouched. Following each backbone’s conditioning format, this step operates on Qwen2.5-VL’s last-layer states (after its 34-token system prefix) in Qwen-Image-2512 and on stacked Qwen3 layers 9, 18, and 27 (padded to 512 tokens) in FLUX.2-klein.

By comparison, four-rollout DiffusionNFT takes 361.5 minutes, and sample-level SFT takes 80.4 minutes on the 400-prompt split (vs. 69.2 minutes for HinT) because failed prompts must be regenerated and re-verified. At inference time, the LoRA adapter merges into the base weights with zero extra latency or VLM calls.

blocks.en: Tab. 7 tests whether restricting the critic to shorter revisions can prevent rewrite drift on SD3.5-M without HinT. Alongside our default full-scene rewrite (23 median words), we evaluate two stricter critic prompts across two seeds: one adapted from UniEvo-VL’s synthesis rules, which asks the critic not to add details beyond its diagnostic notes (15 median words), and an emphasis-only prompt that keeps c c intact except for emphasis words such as clearly , distinct , or exact (10 median words). Full-scene rewrites lift the positive self-teacher above the 19.6 base model to 21.4 GM, though rewrite drift limits this gain and cuts plain backgrounds from 62.2% to 48.2%. Restricting the rewrite fails to help the positive self-teacher: its score drops to 20.1 GM under UniEvo rules and back to the base level (19.5 GM) under minimal edits where r ≈ c r\approx c gives almost no training signal, while under the sunset critic UniEvo rules still transfer sunset lighting to 75.5% of positive-teacher images and 99.3% of cross-author pair images. Removing scene context from T T also lowers alignment across all methods, dropping HinT from 30.9 to 27.2 and 24.8 GM and the cross-author pair from 30.2 to 26.6 and 24.9 GM. Even under these stricter prompts, HinT remains the best-performing method overall: it leads both baselines under Full and UniEvo on the default (30.9 and 27.2 GM) and sunset critics (30.3 and 23.7 GM, with only 2.3% and 4.4% sunset images), and under minimal edits where r ~ ≈ h \tilde{r}\approx h it matches the cross-author pair in GM (24.8 vs. 24.9, over 5 points above the positive teacher) with fewer background additions (74.6% vs. 68.3% plain). Consistent with Sec. 5.1 , scene expansion should therefore be kept in T T for context and canceled in the target rather than restricted in the critic prompt.

blocks.en: To check whether heavy scene rewriting hurts HinT, we ran the default critic on the 1,600 base-model held-out images per backbone, computed each prompt’s rewrite share (the fraction of revision words not in c c ), and split the prompts into three equal groups in Tab. 8 . Shorter user prompts leave more room for the critic to add detail and are also easier for the base model ( e.g . , 21.0 vs. 15.0 base GM on SD3.5-M), so we compare methods on the same prompts within each group. blocks.en: To measure unrequested visual styles independently of the user prompt, InternVL3.5-38B answers four yes/no questions on every evaluation image (and on the 400 round-start training rollouts per round in Fig. 2 c): (1) “Is the scene lit by warm, golden sunset light?”; (2) “Is the scene lit by cold, blue, overcast light?”; (3) “Is the background a plain, uniform color with no scenery?”; and (4) “Does the image look like a vintage film photograph, with faded colors and visible film grain?”. blocks.en: Two control checks rule out potential confounds on both the critic side and the rater side: • Style instructions do not alter error diagnosis. Because round-1 rollouts come from the frozen base model with fixed seeds, different critics can be compared on identical images. Across the 800 Qwen-Image-2512 rollouts, the sunset and cold-light critics agree with the default critic on 98.9% to 99.1% of pass/fail decisions, 99.2% of the 6,012 atomic questions, and 92.4% to 92.6% of failed spans and fixes, while adding the requested lighting to 100% of rejected templates (vs. 0% under the default critic). Across the 400 SD3.5-M rollouts, the sunset and vintage-film critics likewise agree with the default critic on 99.0% to 99.3% of pass/fail decisions and 98.2% to 98.5% of atomic questions. Style instructions thus change only the surrounding template T T , not which errors the critic diagnoses. • Habit rankings do not depend on the rater. Re-scoring 12,000 test images across ten evaluation sets with Qwen3-VL-8B yields close agreement with InternVL3.5-38B on both sunset light ( r = 0.98 r=0.98 per-image correlation, 98.4% binary agreement, and set means differing by at most 2.4 points) and plain backgrounds ( r = 0.92 r=0.92 correlation and 93.7% binary agreement), leaving the method ordering unchanged on every set.

blocks.en: Expanding Rows 9 and 10 of Tab. 4 , Tab. 22 compares three ways to encode ( r , r ~ ) (r,\tilde{r}) on FLUX.2-klein under a frozen teacher. Encoding r r and r ~ \tilde{r} independently lets the slot edit alter surrounding tokens through self-attention ( Sec. 5.2 ), which lowers plain-background rates from 51.4% (base) to 45.2% under the default critic and to 14.9% (with 4.7% sunset) under the sunset critic. Copying only the shared content tokens after the slot ( Suffix alignment ) blocks this leakage, keeping backgrounds clean (62.3% plain, 2.0% sunset) while raising sunset-critic GM from 24.0 to 25.1. If trailing padding states are copied as well ( Suffix + padding copied ), unequal slot lengths shift where padding begins in r r versus r ~ \tilde{r} ; although sunset leakage stays low (2.5%), prompt following drops to 21.9 GM. Removing suffix alignment on Qwen-Image-2512 under the sunset critic similarly lowers GM from 49.3 49.3 ± \pm 1.6 to 47.3 and plain backgrounds from 27.1 27.1 ± \pm 3.9 % to 21.3%. Separately, Tab. 16 breaks down GenEval2 accuracy by skill on Qwen-Image-2512: HinT improves attribute, count, and verb accuracy over the base model under both judges, surpassing the cross-author pair on attributes ( + 8.7 +8.7 points under Soft-TIFA, + 7.4 +7.4 under J2) and verbs ( + 11.4 +11.4 and + 8.0 +8.0 ).

Across three seeds on those sunset-critic runs, hindsight twins reach 23.6 23.6 ± \pm 0.9 GM with 2.2 2.2 ± \pm 0.3 % sunset images, compared with 19.4 19.4 ± \pm 0.7 GM ( 82.1 82.1 ± \pm 2.6 % sunset) for the positive self-teacher and 23.2 23.2 ± \pm 0.1 GM ( 81.9 81.9 ± \pm 6.6 % sunset) for the cross-author pair. Giving the baselines HinT’s evolving-teacher schedule under the default critic does not close the gap either: refreshing the positive self-teacher each round reaches only 22.6 22.6 ± \pm 0.9 GM across three seeds, and scaling Δ pos \Delta_{\rm pos} by λ ​ w ​ ( σ ) \lambda w(\sigma) as in Eq. 3 collapses GM to 11.4 because teacher updates compound rewrite drift. For the cross-author pair, refreshing the teacher at the start of each round (Row 7 of Tab. 4 , 29.2 EMA GM and 46.1 J2) performs nearly the same as the step-wise EMA teacher in Tab. 1 ( 29.1 29.1 ± \pm 1.7 EMA GM and 45.8 45.8 ± \pm 2.4 J2).

blocks.en: On SD3.5-M, HinT’s default schedule reaches 30.7 30.7 ± \pm 1.1 EMA GM at round six and 31.4 31.4 ± \pm 1.0 at round nine. Anchoring accepted rollouts to the frozen base model θ 0 \theta_{0} rather than the round-start teacher θ ¯ \bar{\theta} slightly lowers six-round GM to 30.2, as accepted samples pull the student back toward θ 0 \theta_{0} . At nine rounds, replacing the smooth noise weight w ⁡ ( σ ) = 2 ​ σ w(\sigma)=2\sigma with a hard step 𝟏 [ σ ≥ 0.5 ] \mathbf{1}[\sigma\geq 0.5] drops GM to 24.9, and adding the uncontextualized contrast Δ hind \Delta_{\rm hind} to the target drops it to 24.1. By contrast, decaying the learning rate by 0.85 per round (31.3 GM) or adding 394 training prompts from T2I-CompBench and Pick-a-Pic (31.7 GM) leaves nine-round performance virtually unchanged, showing that the fixed-rate schedule in Alg. 1 is already stable.

Tabs. 23 and 24 report the full seed means, J2 scores, and habit-probe rates for the analyses in Sec. 5 . In Tab. 23 , reintroducing even half-strength rewrite drift ( λ d = 0.5 \lambda_{\rm d}=0.5 ) drives sunset prevalence to 95.4% under the sunset critic; at full drift ( λ d = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm d}=2.0 ) under the default critic, the two seeds diverge toward different habits in the critic’s rewrites, with one filling in scenic backgrounds (27.7% plain, 2.5% sunset) and the other latching onto warm-light descriptions to produce sunset skies on 25.9% of images (78.5% plain). In Tab. 24 , by contrast, replacing up to 50% of valid critiques with critiques from other failed prompts lowers alignment only modestly (from 30.9 to 28.4 GM) without inducing style drift (74.1% plain, 1.4% sunset), since uncorrelated errors cancel out across prompts whereas systematic rewrite habits accumulate. Finally, Figs. 8 and 9 show qualitative comparisons on Qwen-Image-2512 under the default critic and on SD3.5-M under the vintage-film critic.

blocks.en: HinT localizes each correction to a failed phrase inside a shared scene template, which is naturally suited to object attributes, materials, counts, and actions in Tabs. 16 and 19 . When a failure instead stems from global multi-object layout across the canvas, swapping a relational phrase in text provides weaker geometric guidance than explicit spatial conditioning, explaining why 2D spatial gains in Tab. 19 , while consistently positive over every base model, are smaller than attribute gains. Combining slotted twin contrasts with lightweight spatial cues such as critic-predicted bounding boxes is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: HinT 在共享场景模板中将每次校正都本地化为一个失败的短语, 这自然适合 Tabs. 16 和 19 中的对象属性、 材料、 计数和动作 。 当一个失败来自整个画布的全球多对象布局时,在文本中互换一个关系短语比清晰的空间条件提供更弱的几何指导,解释为什么在Tab中2D空间增益. 19 相对于每个基本模型来说,虽然始终是正面的,但比属性收益还小。 将时间档双反差与轻量级空间提示相结合,如批评者预设的边框,是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: While HinT adds zero latency or VLM calls at inference time and finishes post-training in under two hours across backbones, each training rollout still queries a 30B-scale open-source VLM once to produce structured diagnoses and slotted templates; distilling slotted template generation into a smaller verifier could further accelerate larger-scale runs. More broadly, VLM critics in instruction-guided image editing and text-to-video generation similarly introduce unrequested camera motion, pacing, or color grading when expanding prompts, making temporal and editing extensions of HinT an exciting direction for future work [ 34 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然HinT在推论时会增加零延迟或VLM调用,并在两小时内完成跨主干线的后期训练,但每次培训推出仍然会询问一次30B级的开源VLM,以产生结构化诊断和时间档化模板;将时间档化的模板生成分馏到一个较小的验证器中,可以进一步加速更大的运行. 更广泛地说,VLM批评者在指导性图像编辑和文本到视频生成中同样在扩展提示时引入了未经请求的相机运动,速度,或颜色分级,使HinT的时空和编辑扩展成为未来工作的令人振奋的方向[34,43].

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Qualitative comparison on SD3.5-M under the vintage-film critic. Columns share a held-out prompt and seed after six rounds under current weights (rightmost column: seed-1 scores; three-seed means in Tab. 11 ). The positive self-teacher fades the color palette, and the cross-author pair turns scenes into distant, grain-bordered meadows where requested objects shrink or vanish (9.6 to 13.1 GM across seeds vs. 19.6 base).
